definition: Following PMBOK project management: key performance indicators and milestones of the 14-year pilgrimage project

project_basics.project_team: Wukong (Technical Lead) + Zhu Bajie (Outreach) + Sha Wujing (Logistics) + White Dragon Horse (Transport)
project_basics.project_budget: No cash budget · supported by alms + patrons
project_basics.project_scope: From Chang'an to Vulture Peak · 108,000 li · 81 tribulations

kpis.milestone: Chapter 100 · scriptures obtained at Vulture Peak · conferred Buddhist titles
Fall into Tongtian River completes the 81st tribulation
Scriptures taken from the Vulture Peak library · Ananda and Kasyapa solicit bribes (HR bribery risk)
Departs in Zhenguan 13 · returns in Zhenguan 27
1-2 meals daily · begging along the way

milestones.milestone: Recruit Wukong · recruit White Dragon Horse
Recruit Zhu Bajie · recruit Sha Wujing
White Bone Demon · the team's first crisis
Return to Chang'an · confer titles · project complete

project_summary.key_success_factor: Guanyin's timely rescue (13 times) · the tightening band restraining Wukong
project_summary.key_risk_realized: Wukong expelled at White Bone Demon (largest risk) · but successfully resolved
project_summary.lessons_learned: Team building requires early integration · core technology (Wukong) is irreplaceable · external help is a vital resource
